podcast.body: The album's title track, it serves as a quintessential illustration of Tool's thematic interests, specifically referencing the duality between the body and mind. The song explores mystical states achieved through meditation, embodying the band's fascination with these profound and introspective concepts. "La canción de la terá luz es el claro ejemplo de cómo hace referencia a la dualidad, cuerpo y mente, y a todos estos estados místicos en meditación que les gustan."

This song, sometimes referred to as "987," features a highly complex syllable structure in its verses that precisely follows the Fibonacci sequence, starting with one syllable, then one, two, three, five, eight, and subsequently reversing, creating an intricate mathematical pattern within the vocals. "toda la estructura de sílabas en sus versos, sigue la complejísima serie de Fibonacci de una sílaba, una sílaba 2, 3, 5, 8 y vuelve hacia atrás y hace un complejísimo juego siguiendo toda la serie de Fibonacci."

srcs.episode: Tool - Lateralus y la serie de Fibonacci (pero bien explicada)
